notes.note: Eight directions is a march a child can follow; sixteen is a waltz. Choose by what the little feet can keep before they trip over the enchanted dishes.
Novel? No: every ballet master has isolated a phrase and reworked it. Writing the method down, though, is the part I never bothered with. Do it.
Two families, Claude and Codex, so the panel can disagree. Good: a pas de deux needs two partners who know each other's count. And the dreamed Kubernetes can wait.
Codex's engine: 268 tests passing, identical to the byte. Splendid: a corps that hits every mark on every night. Now give it a score, or it is only exact, not alive.
A pet for each guardian: good, the sprite dances the idea in the margin. But a pet that only blinks is wallpaper. Give it a step, and let it keep time.

favorite_idea.why: Stick figures that show each stage in plain motion let the movement explain the pipeline before any architecture has to speak: motion already dancing before any music is added.

steer: Give chapter 3 the speed and pride of a Georgian dance: short, clean scenes that land on the day's own beats, with no line standing still.
